program.name: Afterburn
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: The longest HIIT session: a circuit and a Tabata, or an EMOM and an AMRAP, then abs.
program.about: The longest and hardest HIIT session here, around half an hour. One day is a jump-heavy circuit followed by a Tabata, the other an EMOM followed by an AMRAP. Abs close both. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations. Take a lighter day after it.
